screens.title: Pull requests
screens.summary: Illustrative source directory derived from current code. Rows are invented review examples, not live records.

panels.title: Repository scope and filters
lines: Search title or number; filter source and investigation state.
Open a row to retain the original review queue.

checks: Can reviewers distinguish execution state from saved conclusion?
Does returning restore filters, page, and row focus?
Is repository scope clear before opening a record?

transitions.label: Read saved report
transitions.condition: A readable report is bound to this source.

screens.title: Issues
screens.summary: Illustrative issue directory showing distinct bug and feature assessments. No issue data was fetched.

panels.title: Source context
lines: An imported issue snapshot does not identify a code commit.
Reproduction and implementation remain separate decisions.

checks: Is Not run distinct from Not reproduced?
Can reviewers identify pending product decisions?
Does each entry lead to the correct source and report?

transitions.label: Inspect saved duplicate
transitions.condition: The saved assessment supplies a usable target.

screens.title: Tasks
screens.summary: Illustrative task directory. Status examples describe supported states rather than observed worker activity.

panels.title: Active includes reserved resources
lines: A terminal task can remain Active while cleanup is pending.
Awaiting cleanup is derived from resource leases.

checks: Can users find cancellation that is still awaiting cleanup?
Are saved outcomes independent of current execution?
Does a task row make its next useful action clear?

screens.title: Reports
screens.summary: Illustrative report directory using the current server-cursor model. The review queue covers one directory page.

panels.title: Directory filters
lines: Search; task kind; completeness; delivery; repository scope.
Next cursor changes the directory page, not the report contents.

checks: Is the queue scope visibly limited to the current page?
Are completeness, delivery, and conclusion distinguishable?
Do report filters preserve the selected repository?

screens.title: Pull request source
screens.summary: Illustrative PR detail. The conclusion is saved report data; the source and current task can change independently.

panels.title: Saved conclusion
lines: Illustrative assessment: source-confirmed findings need changes.
Runtime validation: Not run. Completion does not imply approval.

panels.title: About this change
lines: Description and recorded source snapshot.
GitHub source link opens the original PR.

panels.title: Related work
lines: Current investigation and earlier saved reports.
An earlier revision is explicitly identified.

checks: Are conclusion, validation, and current execution separated?
Is a report for an earlier revision hard to mistake for current?
Is the GitHub destination based on this record rather than global scope?

transitions.label: Prepare feedback
transitions.condition: Fresh action context and preparation permission are available.

screens.title: Bug investigation
screens.summary: Illustrative bug assessment. A plausible report with no accepted reproduction remains Needs verification.

panels.title: Reported behavior
lines: Illustrative issue: settings does not open after an update.
Reproduction: Not run. Root cause: not confirmed.

panels.title: Recommended next step
lines: Read the saved reproduction plan and prerequisites.
Choose an exact source commit when the plan needs one.

panels.title: Source and related work
lines: Issue snapshot, imported discussion, and saved report.
Parent records remain available after a linked task is created.

checks: Does Not run avoid implying reproduction failed?
Is the required code revision clear before follow-up?
Can users inspect the saved plan before requesting execution?

transitions.label: Inspect duplicate management
transitions.condition: A separate saved assessment supplies a usable duplicate target.

screens.title: Feature assessment
screens.summary: Illustrative feature assessment. This example presents unresolved requirements, not a ready implementation plan.

panels.title: Feature request
lines: Illustrative request: export a selected subset of settings.
Dependencies, defaults, and compatibility need a decision.

panels.title: Saved plan
lines: Draft plan and acceptance criteria remain reviewable.
A draft alone does not establish execution readiness.

panels.title: Later delivery path
lines: Create PR becomes relevant after verified remote-branch evidence.
The server decides which actions this report permits.

checks: Does the page make unresolved decisions explicit?
Is a draft plan distinct from permission to implement?
Is Create PR tied to verified branch evidence rather than implied progress?

transitions.label: Inspect a later create-PR path
transitions.condition: A subsequent report contains a verified remote branch and allows the action.

screens.title: Task workspace
screens.summary: Illustrative task workspace showing execution, attempts, output, and saved results without claiming a running task.

panels.title: Execution status
lines: Current task state, scheduler progress, and reserved resources.
Saved report and assessment appear separately.

panels.title: Output
lines: Latest retained attempt by default; search and event filters.
Historical attempt output is explicitly labeled.

panels.title: Cancellation and cleanup
lines: Cancel requires confirmation and a fresh task snapshot.
Resources stay reserved until worker cleanup is confirmed.

checks: Can users distinguish historical output from the latest attempt?
Does cancellation explain the wait for cleanup?
Does refreshing preserve readable output without enabling stale actions?

transitions.label: Read saved report
transitions.condition: The report identity matches this task.

transitions.label: Inspect recovery state
transitions.condition: Task is recoverable and cleanup permits recovery.

screens.title: Interrupted task recovery
screens.summary: Illustrative recovery state for a saved checkpoint. Navigating this diagram does not resume or restart anything.

panels.title: Why the task stopped
lines: Illustrative stop reason: a saved budget limit was reached.
Existing assessment stays unchanged when work resumes.

panels.title: Resume budget
lines: Rounds, duration, tokens, and report size with saved usage.
Increase exhausted limits; do not reduce saved limits.

panels.title: Resume versus restart
lines: Saved checkpoint: Resume. No checkpoint: Restart.
Source, scope, profile, and prompt remain unchanged.

checks: Do exhausted fields show specific correction guidance?
Is resume distinct from restarting without a checkpoint?
Are resource cleanup and recovery permission explained before submission?

transitions.label: Resume with reviewed budget
transitions.condition: Server accepts recovery; required limits increase and cleanup is complete.

screens.title: Report reader
screens.summary: Illustrative saved report. Finding text and counts are explanatory examples, not exported report contents.

panels.title: Conclusion and next step
lines: Saved outcome first; validation and completeness stay visible.
Recommended action uses fresh server context.

panels.title: Finding reader
lines: Full-report search, priority, and assessment filters.
Selected findings persist across pages and filters.

panels.title: Feedback draft
lines: Edit current feedback; save it and continue reading.
Review the complete selected set before publication.

checks: Can users locate a P0 hidden by paging or filters?
Are private feedback edits distinct from submitted content?
Does evidence retain its source and validation limits?

transitions.label: Locate P0
transitions.condition: The complete report contains a P0 finding.

transitions.label: Review saved next action
transitions.condition: A saved plan is available.

screens.title: Select findings
screens.route: Report or source > Actions > Select findings
screens.summary: Illustrative publication selection. This action draft has its own selected set and does not overwrite report checkboxes.

panels.title: Choose the operation
lines: Comment, Approve, Suggest code, or Request changes.
Each operation retains its own selection and text.

panels.title: Select from the complete report
lines: Search findings; show all or selected; count hidden selections.
Request changes requires at least one finding.

panels.title: Report selection changed
lines: Use report selection explicitly, or keep this action draft.
Importing selection preserves already edited publishing text.

checks: Is importing report selection explicit and understandable?
Can users inspect every selected finding, including hidden ones?
Does switching actions preserve separate drafts?

transitions.label: Continue with valid selection
transitions.condition: Request changes has at least one finding.

transitions.label: Approve blocked
transitions.condition: The original complete report has a confirmed unresolved P0.

screens.title: Compose publication
screens.summary: Illustrative action draft. The visible fields depend on the chosen operation; navigation sends no content.

panels.title: Summary and finding text
lines: Write a review summary or conversation introduction.
Edit each selected finding without duplicating it in the summary.

panels.title: Include as
lines: Review comment or valid saved suggested change.
Replacement code retains the exact source binding.

panels.title: Review changes and errors
lines: Changed report feedback requires an explicit choice.
An error summary links to stable, labeled fields.

checks: Are comment text and replacement code clearly separated?
Can every field error be reached by keyboard?
Can users keep deliberate publishing edits when report feedback changes?

transitions.label: Request exact server preview
transitions.condition: Fields, source bindings, and preparation permission are valid.

screens.title: Exact action preview
screens.summary: Illustrative preview anatomy shared by supported actions. The actual operation supplies its exact fields and payload.

panels.title: Target and operation
lines: One repository, one source, and one explicit operation.
Reviewed source revision or commit and report reference.

panels.title: Exact payload
lines: Feedback, plan, branch, or duplicate target as applicable.
Intent identity, version, digest, and server guards.

panels.title: Independent confirmation
lines: Preparation does not grant execution permission.
Unsatisfied guards or stale context block confirmation.

checks: Can users identify exactly what will change before confirmation?
Are preparation and execution permission visibly distinct?
Does repeated identical content show an intentional repeat warning?

transitions.label: Explicitly confirm the selected action
transitions.condition: Execution permission and every server guard pass; a known result is returned.

transitions.label: Outcome unconfirmed
transitions.condition: The existing intent remains uncertain after confirmation.

screens.title: Action receipt
screens.summary: Illustrative receipt anatomy for a known result. This diagram does not assert that an action succeeded.

panels.title: Recorded outcome
lines: The server result states success, failure, or cancellation.
Keep the exact submitted content separate from the new draft.

panels.title: Relevant destination
lines: Open linked task only when the receipt includes its task ID.
A follow-up preserves the parent task and saved report.

panels.title: Publish again intentionally
lines: View the previous receipt while editing a fresh draft.
Identical successful content triggers a repeat warning.

checks: Does the receipt retain the submitted content rather than current edits?
Is a linked task offered only when a real result identifies it?
Does another identical submission require an intentional choice?

transitions.label: Open linked task
transitions.condition: The authoritative result contains taskId.

screens.title: P0 approval guard
screens.summary: Illustrative confirmed unresolved P0 case. The guard evaluates the complete original report, not selected findings.

panels.title: Confirmed unresolved P0
lines: Approval is unavailable while the original report blocks it.
Unchecking or filtering a finding does not resolve that guard.

panels.title: Locate the finding
lines: Locate P0 adjusts the finding view across pages.
Inspect the exact evidence and saved assessment.

panels.title: Available next step
lines: Prepare valid feedback or inspect a saved verification plan.
The server remains authoritative for available actions.

checks: Is the reason approval is blocked visible before editing?
Can hidden P0 findings be located from the warning?
Does the interface avoid suggesting selection can bypass the guard?

transitions.label: Prepare request changes
transitions.condition: The action is permitted by current context.

screens.title: Unconfirmed action outcome
screens.summary: Illustrative unknown action result. Checking an existing intent is separate from sending a new action.

panels.title: Keep the existing submission
lines: The outcome is unconfirmed; do not create a second intent.
Edits to a private draft do not alter the submitted payload.

panels.title: Refresh status or check submission
lines: The owner can refresh the saved intent.
Reconciliation requires execution permission and capability.

panels.title: Possible outcomes
lines: A known authoritative result becomes a receipt.
If still unknown, preserve identity and keep this state.

checks: Are refresh and reconciliation clearly separated from resubmission?
Does uncertainty preserve the original intent and payload?
Can a user who lost execution permission still understand the saved status?

transitions.label: Refresh or reconcile existing intent
transitions.condition: The authoritative intent reaches a known result.

transitions.label: Outcome remains unconfirmed
transitions.condition: No authoritative final result is available.

screens.title: Prepare saved follow-up
screens.route: Actions > Start linked task / Verify PR
screens.summary: Illustrative plan-driven follow-up. This is a review of saved inputs and prerequisites, not an execution request.

panels.title: Review the saved plan
lines: Rationale, steps, expected observations, acceptance criteria.
Plan readiness and prerequisites come from server context.

panels.title: Exact source
lines: Issue snapshot: choose the full commit SHA when required.
Frozen plan source: retain its saved commit binding.

panels.title: Execution access
lines: Prepare and execute permissions are distinct.
Task creation, action capability, and repository grant are required.

checks: Is the selected commit the exact source that will execute?
Can users inspect prerequisites before confirmation?
Does the linked task preserve parent report and source navigation?

transitions.label: Prepare plan-bound intent
transitions.condition: Plan, source, permissions, and prerequisites satisfy preparation guards.

transitions.label: Open accepted linked task
transitions.condition: After explicit confirmation, the server receipt supplies taskId.

screens.title: Create pull request
screens.summary: Illustrative current product flow for a report containing verified remote-branch evidence. No branch or PR is created.

panels.title: Verified remote branch
lines: Choose from retained report subjects of kind remote_branch.
The option identifies the branch and saved head SHA.

panels.title: Pull request fields
lines: Title, base branch, and PR body.
Field errors remain attached to the corresponding input.

panels.title: Exact creation preview
lines: Review target, source branch, base, and submitted text.
Creation requires separate confirmation and server guards.

checks: Are only report-bound verified remote branches selectable?
Are base branch and PR text clear before confirmation?
Does missing branch evidence block the action with a useful reason?

transitions.label: Prepare create-PR intent
transitions.condition: Verified branch, required fields, and current action guards are valid.

screens.title: Close issue as duplicate
screens.summary: Illustrative current product flow using a saved duplicate target. This is not ordinary Close and does not alter an issue.

panels.title: Saved duplicate target
lines: Read-only target shows the retained identifier and issue number.
The target comes from the saved assessment.

panels.title: Missing or unusable target
lines: Show No usable saved target and field-level guidance.
Reload the report or choose another operation.

panels.title: Review the exact effect
lines: Preview the source issue and saved duplicate destination.
Use separate confirmation before the action is executed.

checks: Is the duplicate destination visibly bound to saved evidence?
Does a missing target prevent an ambiguous closure?
Can users distinguish duplicate closure from ordinary Close?

transitions.label: Prepare duplicate closure
transitions.condition: The saved target is usable and current guards allow the operation.

transitions.label: Reload or inspect saved assessment
transitions.condition: No usable saved duplicate target exists.

journeys.title: Review findings and prepare publication
journeys.summary: Read a saved outcome, deliberately select feedback, inspect the exact payload, and review a known result. All data is illustrative.

steps.label: Choose source
steps.note: Capture the filtered review queue.

steps.label: Understand outcome
steps.note: Separate conclusion from validation and execution.

steps.label: Read findings
steps.note: Inspect evidence and save private feedback.

steps.label: Select deliberately
steps.note: The action draft owns its own selection.

steps.label: Compose
steps.note: Review finding text and valid suggestions.

steps.label: Inspect exact action
steps.note: Execution needs a separate confirmation.

steps.label: Read receipt
steps.note: Only an authoritative result establishes an outcome.

journeys.title: Inspect an approval blocker
journeys.summary: Review a confirmed unresolved P0 from the complete original report; selection and filtering cannot bypass the guard.

steps.label: Open saved report
steps.note: The directory queue covers its current page.

steps.label: Locate P0
steps.note: The warning can reach findings outside the visible page.

steps.label: Understand the guard
steps.note: Approve remains blocked by original report content.

steps.label: Prepare feedback
steps.note: Use an available action to address the finding.

branches.label: Inspect an available saved verification plan

journeys.title: Recover an interrupted investigation
journeys.summary: Inspect the stop reason and retained state, review the budget, and follow a new attempt only after accepted recovery.

steps.label: Find work needing attention
steps.note: A saved checkpoint is not a final conclusion.

steps.label: Review recovery
steps.note: Raise exhausted limits and respect cleanup constraints.

steps.label: Follow the latest attempt
steps.note: This transition is conditional on server acceptance.

steps.label: Read saved results
steps.note: Resume does not rewrite the earlier assessment.

branches.label: Budget invalid, permission absent, or cleanup pending

journeys.title: Move from issue assessment to linked work
journeys.summary: Review a saved plan and exact source before requesting linked work; a child task is navigable only when returned by the server.

steps.label: Choose issue
steps.note: Bug verification and feature decisions differ.

steps.label: Read assessment
steps.note: Not run does not mean Not reproduced.

steps.label: Review plan and source
steps.note: Issue snapshot plans may require a full commit SHA.

steps.label: Inspect bound intent
steps.note: Preparation and execution access remain separate.

steps.label: Read accepted result
steps.note: Only a receipt with taskId offers a child-task link.

steps.label: Inspect linked task
steps.note: Retain navigation to the parent task and report.

branches.label: Missing source, incomplete plan, or unmet prerequisite

journeys.title: Recover an unconfirmed action outcome
journeys.summary: Preserve the existing intent and distinguish status reads from permission-gated reconciliation. No new action is inferred.

steps.label: Inspect the prepared intent
steps.note: Exact target and payload are already bound.

steps.label: Keep the uncertain submission
steps.note: Do not replace uncertainty with a new submission.

steps.label: Review a known result
steps.note: Proceed only when the authoritative intent has a known outcome.

steps.label: Return to private draft
steps.note: The prior submitted snapshot stays unchanged.

branches.label: Still unknown after refresh or reconciliation
Leave while preserving the pending submission
